verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a codebase-conventions context file (such as a project instructions file) that agents read to shape plans and code. The closest items are adjacent features that do not deliver this story: Markdown output-style files, which govern response style; reusable Skills; and a vague 'project context' mention in the CLI overview.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a context file describing my codebase conventions so agents generate more relevant plans and code
